# XMR Swap — Exchange Monero Cross-Chain Reference

> Exchange Monero (XMR) — a privacy-focused, non-EVM coin — for stablecoins and tokens on other chains, using atomic swaps or non-custodial instant exchange services.

## Key Facts
- XMR: native coin of the Monero blockchain, a standalone, non-EVM privacy network
- Not an ERC-20 token — Ethereum wallets and same-chain DEXs do not hold XMR directly
- Swap paths: atomic swap (wallet-to-wallet, non-custodial), instant exchange service, or CEX where listed
- XMR↔EVM requires a cross-chain route, not a same-chain DEX trade
- Costs: Monero network fee + exchange/service fee & spread + destination network fee
- Some centralized exchanges have delisted/restricted privacy coins by jurisdiction; availability varies
- Monero payments are private and not reversible once sent
